images.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a single landscape 3:2 editorial travel photograph for Red Sea Horizons, an Egyptian Red Sea tourism website. This is illustrative marketing imagery, not documentation of a real supplier. Natural light, realistic proportions and textures, restrained warm sand and turquoise palette, believable travel photography with gentle film texture, no heavy HDR. Full bleed image only: no text, letters, logos, watermark, border, collage or interface. Keep main subjects within the central 70% so the scene also crops well to 4:3. Eastern Desert of Egypt near the Red Sea, a quiet ochre desert valley with rugged layered limestone and granite hills, soft wind-shaped sand in the foreground, one tiny unoccupied off-road vehicle far in the middle distance giving scale. Late afternoon side light, open pale blue sky, calm adventurous mood. Eye-level wide view; realistic geography, not enormous Sahara dunes.
